text: Your AI just lied to you, and it had no idea.
AI doesn't look up facts. It predicts the next most likely word.
So when it doesn't know, it still gives you something that sounds right.
onScreenText: Sounds right is not the same as is right

text: Ask for a function that doesn't exist, and it will happily write the code.
The fix: ask for sources, run the code, and never trust blindly.
Your AI just lied to you.
